name: Workflow connectors (block catalogue)
description: Reusable managed workflow connections with write-only OpenBao credentials. External actions default to Simulation; Real requires a selected connection and explicit confirmation. Legacy credential settings are no longer accepted. Demo sheet remains simulated.

settings.label: HTTP block: allowed hosts
settings.help: Exact destination host names this block may call. Empty refuses all outbound calls. Redirects are not followed. Only add hosts you trust; local/private hosts expose local services.

settings.label: Publish block: authorized workflow ids
settings.help: Exact ids (comma separated) of the workflow definitions allowed to publish their run branch to main with the lyam-publish-workspace block. Empty refuses every publication. Read from main at run time: a run cannot change it.

settings.label: Mail block: allowed recipients
settings.help: Exact e-mail addresses (comma separated) the lyam-send-mail block may write to. Empty refuses every send. Set only to addresses the owner approved.

settings.label: Mail block: sender address
settings.help: Must be on a domain verified at the mail provider. The provider API key is never a setting: it is the RESEND_API_KEY environment variable of the server.
